bull.b: Sustained ARR growth and a faster-growing SaaS ARR enlarge the recurring revenue base, boosting predictability and upsell potential. A larger, subscription-centric ARR supports durable cash flow conversion, higher retention economics and scalable go-to-market efficiency over quarters.

bull.t: Improving cash generation and margin expansion
bull.b: The company swung to positive operating and free cash flow and is guiding materially higher FCF for the year, reducing reliance on external financing. Improved margins and cash conversion create durable financial flexibility to invest in product and sales while lowering liquidity risk.

Agentic Fabric, nonhuman identity capabilities and partner integrations expand addressable market and create technical differentiation. Emerging products already contributed meaningfully to net new ARR, supporting sustainable product-led expansion and competitive positioning over the medium term.

bear.t: Persistent GAAP losses and negative margins
bear.b: Despite revenue and ARR momentum, the company still reports sizable GAAP losses and deeply negative operating margins. Converting strong SaaS growth into sustained GAAP profitability is not yet achieved, leaving execution and margin risk until multiple quarters of stable profitability occur.

Prior negative equity and swings in leverage signal past capital-structure stress. Although recent metrics improved, historical volatility raises the risk of future refinancing, dilution, or constrained access to debt markets if cash generation falters or execution slips.

bear.t: Execution dependency on migrations and early-stage monetization
bear.b: A meaningful legacy on-prem footprint and early-stage Agentic monetization create execution risk: migrations must convert to SaaS at modeled rates and new products must monetize. Delays or slower adoption would push revenue recognition and margin improvement further out.
